 India bolster pace attack for New Zealand ODIs 
 Auqib Nabi was initially named in the squad for the fourth and fifth ODIs but will now be available for the full series.
 31 October, 2026 India have bolstered their pace-bowling options ahead of their five-match ODI series against New Zealand, as the Men’s Selection Committee have added Auqib Nabi to India’s squad for the first three ODIs of the upcoming series.
 Nabi was initially named in the unit for the fourth and fifth ODIs but will now be available from the beginning of the series, starting Wednesday, November 4.
 The 29-year-old made his debut in last month's second ODI against the West Indies.
 India have also retained the rest of their originally announced squad for the first three matches, with Nitish Kumar Reddy available only for the opening ODI.
 Earlier, India had announced that Prasidh Krishna will sit out the ODI series after being unable to secure a fitness clearance.

 India’s updated ODI squad for the first three ODIs: Shubman Gill (c), Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, Shreyas Iyer, KL Rahul, Axar Patel, Naman Dhir, Anshul Kamboj, Gurnoor Brar, Ruturaj Gaikwad, Arshdeep Singh, Ishan Kishan, Mohammed Siraj, Kuldeep Yadav, Nitish Kumar Reddy (first ODI only), Auqib Nabi.
 India’s ODI squad for the fourth and fifth ODIs: Shreyas Iyer (c), Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, Tilak Varma, Ishan Kishan, Axar Patel, Naman Dhir, Auqib Nabi, Gurnoor Brar, Ruturaj Gaikwad, Arshdeep Singh, Kumar Kushagra, Mohammed Siraj, Yash Thakur, Kuldeep Yadav.
 The two sides are currently engaged in a five-match T20I series, where India have a unassailable 3-1 lead with the final T20I set for Sunday, November 1.
 Nabi has thus far featured in a solitary ODI in which he was wicketless against the West Indies. But the right-arm pacer impressed in the recent India 'A' outing against New Zealand 'A', picking six wickets across two innings of the first-class game.
 Series Schedule: 
 First ODI: 4 November, Auckland
 Second ODI : 7 November, Wellington
 Third ODI: 10 November, Hamilton
 Fourth ODI : 13 November, Mount Maunganui
 Fifth ODI: 15 November, Mount Maunganui
